# Green Falls Co.

Green Falls Co. is a marketing studio based in Maine. We build websites, improve local search visibility, create customer emails and set up practical AI for independent businesses across Maine and the Northeast.

## Services

- Website design and local SEO: https://greenfalls.co/services/website-creation-seo-aeo
- Email marketing, including Klaviyo flows and campaigns: https://greenfalls.co/services/email-lifecycle-retention
- AI consulting and setup for one repeated task: https://greenfalls.co/services/ai-implementation
- Marketing consultation and a 90-day plan: https://greenfalls.co/services/marketing-consultation

## Who we help

Independent businesses: trades and home services, specialty shops and repair businesses, restaurants and hospitality. See https://greenfalls.co/who-we-help

## How a project works

You review a written project plan and cost before work starts, see working drafts along the way, and receive the files, access and instructions at handover. See https://greenfalls.co/approach

## Guides

Practical guides on website inquiries, redesign proposals, email automation and AI customer replies: https://greenfalls.co/insights
